P1.name: Competitor Price Monitor
P1.integrationDecision: Adapter can be built from observed/store price records.

P2.name: Margin Guard Agent
P2.integrationDecision: Do not infer margin guardrails from target-price logic. Requires explicit unit-cost/margin-floor rules.

P3.name: Demand Elasticity Estimator
currentEvidence: linear price trend exists, but price trend is not demand elasticity
P3.integrationDecision: Do not relabel existing trend regression as elasticity.

P4.name: Markdown & Promotion Pricing Agent
P4.integrationDecision: Requires I4 + D4 + P2 + promotion constraints.

P5.name: Price Recommendation & Fairness Gate
currentEvidence: PriceAgent.analyze returns WATCH/BUY/WAIT style deal advice
P5.integrationDecision: Current deal advice may be retained as evidence/context only; it must not become canonical executable PriceRecommendation until the missing guards exist.
